title: Domains
subtitle: List all your registered domains, bulk select to change status or delete.

empty.title: No domains yet
empty.desc: Get started by adding your first domain. A Linux user, nginx vhost, PHP-FPM pool, FTP account, MySQL database and DNS zone will be created automatically.

create_modal.title: Create New Domain
create_modal.desc: A Linux user, nginx vhost, PHP-FPM pool, FTP account, MySQL database and DNS zone will be set up automatically.
create_modal.domain_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and dots. E.g.: site.com or panel.site.com
create_modal.ssl_warning_with_ip: ⚠ The domain's DNS A record must point to this server's IP address ({{ip}}) before the certificate is issued — otherwise Let's Encrypt validation will fail and the site will temporarily be set up with a self-signed certificate (you can retry from Subscription → SSL once DNS is fixed).
create_modal.ssl_warning_no_ip: ⚠ The domain's DNS A record must point to this server's IP address before the certificate is issued — otherwise Let's Encrypt validation will fail and the site will temporarily be set up with a self-signed certificate (you can retry from Subscription → SSL once DNS is fixed).
create_modal.validation_error: Invalid domain name. E.g.: example.com or panel.example.com
create_modal.success: ✓ "{{name}}" created — Linux user, nginx vhost, PHP-FPM pool, FTP account, MySQL DB and DNS zone ready.
create_modal.ssl_error: ⚠ SSL could not be installed — You can retry from Subscription → SSL page.

result_modal.title: ✓ Domain Created
result_modal.desc_before: is provisioned. The passwords below are shown
result_modal.desc_after: — please save them in a safe place.
result_modal.clipboard_prompt: Press Ctrl+C to copy, then Enter:

delete_modal.title: ⚠ Bulk Domain Deletion
delete_modal.desc: {{count}} domain(s) and all dependent resources (Linux user, home directory, DB, FTP, vhost, DNS zone) will be permanently deleted.
